metadata.client: Screen Sharing 3.0 application with Tahoe framework and disposable compatibility/timing adapter

method: Two 30-second scrolling intervals per instrumented case, one 30-second uninstrumented server CPU validation. Plain VNC URLs. Client timing adapter present in all cases.

release_validation.note: handleFrameBufferUpdate callbacks occur per rectangle, not once per RFB update. Without server tracing this run validates process CPU only; no frame rate or end-to-end latency is inferred from callback counts.

limitations: Loopback VirtualMac2,1; not real macOS 13 client or LAN.
Screen Sharing 3.0 uses Tahoe framework plus compatibility adapter.
Workload overlaps viewer; other desktop activity and existing server sessions were not isolated.
Capture PTS is presentation time and sometimes follows frame readiness; use separate copy-start and readiness measurements.
Draw submission does not prove frame identity or physical display scanout.
Different cases contain different pixel data and compression ratios; process deltas are not isolated causal estimates.
Plaintext socket vector writes bypass socket_write_raw probe; use encrypt_and_write.
Client callbacks are per rectangle; instrumented frame timing uses exact cumulative inflate-byte matching.
System-zlib trace has one incomplete shutdown frame outside every measured sample. All measured updates match.
